name: decommissioning_project_mirr_signed_flows
question_template: A project pays an outlay of {I0} USD at time 0 and receives an operating inflow of {C} USD at the end of each of years 1 to {N}. At the end of year {N} it also pays a decommissioning cost of {D} USD; the year-{N} net flow is the inflow minus that cost and may be positive, zero or negative. Inflows are positive, outflows negative. NPV is computed on the net flows at {R} percent per year. For the modified IRR, classify each year's net flow by sign: negative net flows (including the time-0 outlay) are discounted to time 0 at a finance rate of {F} percent per year, positive net flows are compounded to the end of year {N} at a reinvestment rate of {K} percent per year, and a zero net flow is ignored. The MIRR is the annual rate that grows that total present value into that total future value over {N} years. Compute the MIRR as a percentage.

slots.description: Net present value of all net cash flows at the stated discount rate
Whether the NPV is strictly positive
Total present value at time 0 of negative net flows at the finance rate
Total future value at final year of positive net flows at the reinvestment rate

program:
def solve():
    I0 = Q(P["I0"])
    C = Q(P["C"])
    D = Q(P["D"])
    N = int(P["N"])
    r = Q(P["R"]) / 100
    f = Q(P["F"]) / 100
    k = Q(P["K"]) / 100
    if I0 <= 0 or C <= 0 or N < 1:
        raise ValueError("invalid project inputs")
    net_last = C - D
    npv = -I0
    for t in range(1, N):
        npv += C / (1 + r) ** t
    npv += net_last / (1 + r) ** N
    npv_positive = "positive" if npv > 0 else "not_positive"
    pv_neg = I0
    if net_last < 0:
        pv_neg += (-net_last) / (1 + f) ** N
    fv_pos = Q(0)
    for t in range(1, N):
        fv_pos += C * (1 + k) ** (N - t)
    if net_last > 0:
        fv_pos += net_last
    if pv_neg <= 0 or fv_pos <= 0:
        raise ValueError("MIRR undefined")
    ratio = fv_pos / pv_neg
    mirr = (exp(ln(ratio) / N) - 1) * 100
    return {"final": mirr, "npv": npv, "npv_positive": npv_positive, "pv_negative_flows": pv_neg, "fv_positive_flows": fv_pos}
